Turning to the overnight tape. The S&P 500 closed at 7,749, a level it has not
held for long. The Nasdaq Composite added 0.54%.

On rates. The two-year sits at 4.20%, down 2 basis points. The ten-year is at

Volatility stayed contained, with the VIX at 14.6.
